front.title: Simple Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol (STAMP) over UDP-Lite

abstract.t:
This document specifies the Simple Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol (STAMP) as defined in RFC 8762 and extended in RFC 8972, over the Lightweight User Datagram Protocol (UDP-Lite) for IPv4 and IPv6. Partial checksum coverage accommodates timestamp insertion after the checksum computation while protecting the integrity of transport header and IP pseudo-header.
This document updates RFC 8762 to permit an explicitly selected UDP- Lite transport with the existing UDP port number rules.
This document also updates RFC 8972 for transport-aware session identification, payload length determination, UDP port number reporting in the Location TLV, and replacing the use of the UDP Length field for detecting optional STAMP TLVs. STAMP payload formats and existing UDP-based sessions are unchanged.
